Class Layer

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.Layer
Direct Known Subclasses:
CityLayer, CountryBoundaryLayer, CountryFillLayer, Etopo5Layer, GraticuleLayer, ShapefileLayer
public class Layer extends Object
A z-layer (drawing layer) that owns an ordered list of AItem objects.

Role in the MDI rendering model

  View → Container → Layers → Items

Layers are rendered bottom-to-top by the owning container. The layer manages item ordering, selection state, hit-testing, and notifies registered ItemChangeListeners when items are added, removed, or selected.

Visibility vs. locking

  • Visible layers are drawn and participate in hit-testing.
  • Locked layers are still drawn (if visible) but their items are treated as non-interactive: hit-testing returns null, selection helpers are no-ops, and deletion helpers skip locked layers.

Why delegation instead of inheritance

This class delegates to an internal ArrayList rather than extending one. Extending ArrayList would expose the full List mutation API (add(int, E), set(), addAll(), etc.) to callers, making it trivial to bypass the change-notification logic in add(AItem) and remove(AItem). The delegation approach exposes only the operations this layer actually supports, each of which fires the correct event.

Thread safety

Mutating operations synchronize on this to provide basic safety when background threads modify items while the Swing EDT is painting.

  • Constructor Details

    • Layer

      public Layer(IContainer container, String name)
      Create a z-layer and register it with the owning container.

      The layer auto-registers itself via IContainer.addLayer(Layer).

      Parameters:
      container - the owning container; must not be null
      name - a human-readable layer name; must not be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either argument is null

  • Method Details

    • add

      public void add(AItem item)
      Add an item to the top of this layer and notify listeners.

      Items normally add themselves to their layer inside AItem(Layer, Object...). Re-adding an item already present on this layer is a no-op.

      Parameters:
      item - the item to add; must belong to this layer
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if item is null or belongs to a different layer

    • remove

      public boolean remove(AItem item)
      Remove an item from this layer.

      If the item is present, it is removed first, then AItem.prepareForRemoval() is called and a ItemChangeType.DELETED event is fired. An item not owned by this layer is left untouched.

      Parameters:
      item - the item to remove; if null or not on this layer the call is a no-op
      Returns:
      true if the item was found and removed

    • clearAllItems

      public void clearAllItems(IContainer container)
      Delete all deletable items from this layer, properly detaching each from container-managed services (feedback control, etc.).

      If this layer is locked the call is a no-op.

      Parameters:
      container - retained for source compatibility; item cleanup uses this layer's owning container

    • deleteSelectedItems

      public void deleteSelectedItems(IContainer container)
      Delete all currently selected, deletable items.

      If this layer is locked or not visible the call is a no-op.

      Parameters:
      container - retained for source compatibility; item cleanup uses this layer's owning container

    • deleteItem

      public void deleteItem(AItem item)
      Delete a single item from this layer.

      If this layer is locked the call is a no-op. The item is detached from the container's feedback control and AItem.prepareForRemoval() is called before removal.

      Parameters:
      item - the item to delete; if null the call is a no-op

    • getAllItems

      public ArrayList<AItem> getAllItems()
      Return a snapshot of all items on this layer, in draw order (bottom-to-top).

      The returned list is a defensive copy — modifications to it do not affect this layer.

      Returns:
      a new, mutable ArrayList of all items; never null

      public void selectAllItems(boolean select, AItem excludedItem)
